actual: After the 2026-08-13 user restart, backend-main loaded a descendant of both merged BUG-992 slices, but production run simrun_7bf1e0c1b6b7d055 remained FAILED_RETRYABLE. Its durable payload contains continuous economic generations 1..4: generations 1..3 belong to predecessor plan plan_295a79eab064130c, while generation 4 and the current run identity belong to cash-fit successor plan plan_4e346c75b6a5f0e5. The strict closure incorrectly required every historical receipt/state to use the current plan and failed with LOCALSIM_DURABLE_STATE_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT; after authority selection, active FAILED_RETRYABLE generations were still excluded from the durable minute-loop recovery path.

expected: A LocalSIM run may retain hash-closed predecessor-plan generations after an explicitly recorded side-effect-free rebuild and cash-fit successor, while the latest committed generation remains the only execution owner. Cross-plan receipt/state history must be accepted only when generation order, rebuild/cash-fit lineage, exact state hashes, intent set and execution semantics close; any unknown plan, sequence rollback, hash, identity or semantic drift must fail loud. Historical FAILED_RETRYABLE and FAILED_TERMINAL active generations must automatically continue through the existing durable minute loop without parent resubmit or predecessor projection replay.
fix_summary: Accept exactly one monotonic predecessor-to-current LocalSIM plan transition only when existing rebuild/cash-fit metadata, receipt generations, economic identities, predecessor/current state hashes, intent set and execution semantics all close. Keep latest generation as the sole execution authority and predecessor states audit-only. Extend the existing no-parent-resubmit durable active-generation recovery to historical FAILED_RETRYABLE while preserving distinct retryable/terminal evidence schemas and reason codes.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
root_cause: The first authority repair assumed a run has one plan identity for its full economic receipt history. In the observed production lifecycle, side-effect-free LocalSIM plan rebuild and subsequent cash-fit legitimately produced predecessor and successor plans in one run: generations 1..3 plus 246 predecessor states remain auditable, while generation 4 plus 246 successor states are current. The closure rejected the valid predecessor history before selecting generation 4. Separately, historical active-generation recovery only admitted FAILED_TERMINAL, so a FAILED_RETRYABLE current generation could never be driven to terminal closure even after authority readback succeeded.
